title: Bind the Full downset allocation to actual Gaussian common grids
body:
PR #4977's smaller Full allocation did not yet reach the actual Gaussian wrappers: RawGaussian's provisional allocation could retain the original larger common-grid floor. This package binds the unchanged normalized/root and raw/provisional/child code to that certified allocator through private method globals, preserving frozen files, all original validation, immutable reference pages and gauge arithmetic.

The written quantified argument proves the raw/normalized grid fixed point and retains the original radius, forward/inverse error and recomputed intermediate-width obligations. Actual fixtures reduce normalized child/data precision from240/134 to55/72 and raw broad from539/261 to114/119; a nonzero512-bit incoming grid remains512. These are fixture measurements, not universal fixed savings.

Validation: registered CPython3.12 normal/optimized replay; five actual normalized/narrow/broad callers,20rounded forward/stored-inverse trajectories and five controls;28-file committed-byte/source-history preflight; official export integrity; Git-free normal/optimized replays with PATH empty, source and bool/int receipt corruption rejection, and unchanged exported bytes after restoration. Hosted CI is unverified when opening this PR.

The Full/downset, Gaussian conditioning/interval and local-fragment theorems are retained dependencies. Complete core/tensor composition, offline coefficient/reference preparation and delivery, physical tapes, full supplier admission and a newκ are not established. The new package includes one concrete next caller question and stops here.

Canonical record: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202#discussioncomment-19139351. Base `bee95ce88f9f19802f0613f92838895cd0e14a1f`, priority7.
